findings.message: Params colaboradorId, categoria and page have effect filter:despesasAprovadasLista but no state holds them. Added public persisted states colaboradorId, categoria and page; listarDespesasAprovadas({colaboradorId, categoria, page, append}) publishes them and loads.

Param despesaId selects despesaAprovadaDetalhe but no public selection method exists. Added selectDespesaAprovadaDetalhe(id|null), which calls obterDespesaAprovada(id) and keeps the id in selectedDespesa; the record is in despesa.

registrarPagamento is submitted from the form registroPagamentoForm but no state has source registrarPagamento.input. Added registrarPagamentoDraft (RegistrarPagamentoDraft) with setRegistrarPagamentoDraft.
registrarPagamento returns despesa, which no state has as source; applied it to the despesa state (redraw) and removed the paid expense from despesas by id, as the route comment says (no reload).
